verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that Dover runs as an MCP server, exposing its jobs and candidates to external AI clients. Nothing shows that Dover can act as an MCP client and connect to outside MCP servers to use their tools. Server-side evidence is a different story and does not transfer here, so the axis applies but is unsupported.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
